en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Overview of metabolic diseases, congenital genetic diseases and human infection diseases and the role of the molecular biology in their diagnostics.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Congenital Genetic Diseases (allowance 4/0) a.a. Introduction to Molecular Biology of Diseasesb.b. Metabolic Disordersc.c. Neonatal Epilepsyd.d. Neuromuscular Disorderse.e. Skin and Connective Tissue Diseases2.Molecular Biology of Haematological Disorders (allowance 2/0) a.a. Thrombophilic Mutationsb.b. Haematooncology3.Prenatal Diagnostics (allowance 2/0) a.a. Congenital aberration4.Molecular Diagnostics in Microbiology (allowance 8/0) a.a. Respiratory Infectionsb.b. Sexually Transmitted Infectionsc.c. Transplantation Infections (IT pathogens)d.d. Blood Borne Infections (Hepatitis, HIV)e.e. Other diseases (Gastrointestinal Infections, Neuroinfections)5.Molecular Biology of Resistances (allowance 4/0) a.a. Antibiotic resistance (MSRA, VRE, ESBL)b.b. Antivirotic resistance6.Laboratory Practice (allowance 0/6) a.a. Excursion to a biotechnology company producing diagnostics assays for microbiological and genetic laboratories. Lecture about the company, excursions to laboratories
